args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but src/money.py implemented round_money with ROUND_HALF_UP. This changes the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so the tests pass.

CI: run ci-0001 on this branch passed (sha 08d3cd5986).
